folds.title: What a model is
points: An **AI model** is a program that learned patterns from huge amounts of text.
It does not look answers up.

folds.title: One piece at a time
points: Type "The sky is" and the likely next word is `blue`.
Claude predicts one small piece at a time, very fast.
Strings of predictions add up to emails, stories and code.

folds.title: Why it can be wrong
points: It feels like understanding, but it is pattern-matching at a huge scale.
So it can sound sure and still be wrong.

folds.title: Ask twice

chat.you: Write a short poem about Mondays.
Write a short poem about Mondays.

folds.note: Same question, two poems. Each word is a fresh prediction, not a stored answer.

folds.question: Complete it: "Peanut butter and ..."
folds.why: Right! The model picks what is most likely, based on patterns it learned.
